plugins.name: Archify
plugins.summaryEn: Architecture knowledge and diagrams exposed to DSH through a nested integration bundle.
plugins.summaryZh: 通过仓库内的嵌套集成 bundle，为 DSH 提供架构知识与图表能力。
plugins.noteEn: Native structure confirmed in a nested package; runtime compatibility was not tested.
plugins.noteZh: 已确认嵌套包中的原生结构；未做运行兼容性测试。

plugins.name: DSH Web UI All
plugins.summaryEn: An aggregate Web UI bundle combining task board, Git, terminal, remote UI, stats, pets, and skins.
plugins.summaryZh: 聚合任务看板、Git、终端、远程 UI、统计、桌宠与皮肤的 Web UI bundle。
plugins.noteEn: Broad aggregate scope and a prepare build require elevated review before use.
plugins.noteZh: 聚合范围很广且包含 prepare 构建，使用前需要更高强度的审查。

plugins.name: ModLens
plugins.summaryEn: A vision bridge that turns images into structured OCR, layout, and semantic evidence for text-only models.
plugins.summaryZh: 把图片转换为 OCR、布局和语义证据，为纯文本模型补充视觉能力。
plugins.noteEn: External vision engines and credentials are capability facts, not a safety judgment.
plugins.noteZh: 外部视觉引擎与凭据属于能力事实，不代表安全性判断。

plugins.name: Aegis
plugins.summaryEn: A software-engineering method pack for planning, debugging, prompt hygiene, verification, and repair tracking.
plugins.summaryZh: 面向规划、调试、提示词卫生、完成前验证与修复追踪的软件工程方法包。
plugins.noteEn: Repository license is MIT; the fixed package manifest has no license field.
plugins.noteZh: 仓库许可证为 MIT；固定提交的包 manifest 未声明 license 字段。

plugins.name: SandBase Harness
plugins.summaryEn: A managed-agent integration with a DSH patch example and external service credentials.
plugins.summaryZh: 带 DSH patch 示例并连接外部服务凭据的托管 Agent 集成。
plugins.noteEn: Held because the public distribution identity is ambiguous and name-colliding.
plugins.noteZh: 因公开分发身份不明确且存在名称冲突而暂缓。

plugins.name: DSH Vision Toolkit
plugins.summaryEn: Vision tools for image Q&A, long-screenshot OCR, UI reproduction, grounding, and pixel diff.
plugins.summaryZh: 提供图像问答、长截图 OCR、UI 复刻、视觉定位与像素差异分析。
plugins.noteEn: High-privilege runtime preparation is visible; compatibility requires a separate check.
plugins.noteZh: 源码显示高权限运行准备；兼容性仍需单独核验。

plugins.name: DSH TUI
plugins.summaryEn: A full-screen terminal client with live status, streaming thoughts, tools, approvals, and filesystem access.
plugins.summaryZh: 带实时状态、流式思考、工具、审批与文件系统能力的全屏终端客户端。
plugins.noteEn: The bundle exposes a broad agent surface; structure confirmation is not a runtime endorsement.
plugins.noteZh: 该 bundle 暴露较广的 Agent 能力面；结构确认不代表运行背书。

plugins.name: DSH Better Sidebar
plugins.summaryEn: A sidebar workbench with file editing, terminal, Git, media, and extensible tabs.
plugins.summaryZh: 集文件编辑、终端、Git、媒体预览和可扩展标签页于一体的侧边工作台。
plugins.noteEn: Direct package installation exists, but remote installer scripts and native builds warrant review.
plugins.noteZh: 虽提供直接包安装，远程安装脚本与原生构建仍需重点审查。

plugins.name: DSH Agent Teams
plugins.summaryEn: Team-style agent orchestration with persisted state and child-process coordination.
plugins.summaryZh: 带持久化状态与子进程协调的团队式 Agent 编排。
plugins.noteEn: Held because most declared DSH peer ranges target rc.1 rather than the rc.6 review baseline.
plugins.noteZh: 大多数 DSH peer range 仍指向 rc.1，落后于 rc.6 核验基线，因此暂缓。

plugins.name: DSH At File
plugins.summaryEn: Codex-style @file mentions that search workspace paths and attach file contents to prompts.
plugins.summaryZh: 提供类似 Codex 的 @file 引用，搜索工作区路径并把文件内容附加到提示词。
plugins.noteEn: Workspace contents can be attached to prompts; users should review disclosure boundaries.
plugins.noteZh: 工作区内容可能被附加到提示词，需审查数据披露边界。

plugins.name: DSH Market
plugins.summaryEn: An in-harness plugin market that can browse, install, update, and remove third-party packages.
plugins.summaryZh: 可在 Harness 内浏览、安装、更新和移除第三方包的插件市场。
plugins.noteEn: Package-manager control makes this a high-trust surface; listing is not an endorsement.
plugins.noteZh: 包管理控制使其成为高信任能力面；收录不代表背书。

plugins.name: DSH Visualize
plugins.summaryEn: In-conversation generative UI with streaming interactive HTML cards and sandboxed rendering.
plugins.summaryZh: 在对话中生成可流式预览的交互式 HTML 卡片，并使用沙箱渲染。
plugins.noteEn: The package is private; only GitHub-source evidence was observed.
plugins.noteZh: 包标记为 private；目前只观察到 GitHub 源安装证据。

plugins.name: DSH GenUI
plugins.summaryEn: Interactive inline UI for layouts, charts, forms, quizzes, Mermaid, 3D scenes, and action events.
plugins.summaryZh: 在回复中渲染布局、图表、表单、测验、Mermaid、3D 场景和交互事件。
plugins.noteEn: Git-source install and dynamic client rendering are explicit review surfaces.
plugins.noteZh: Git 源安装与动态客户端渲染是明确的重点审查面。

plugins.name: DSH Memory Evolve
plugins.summaryEn: A DSH-oriented memory and orchestration client whose fixed manifest lacks a native bundle declaration.
plugins.summaryZh: 面向 DSH 的记忆与编排客户端，但固定 manifest 缺少原生 bundle 声明。
plugins.noteEn: Held because dsh.client is present but dsh.bundle and a referenced patch are absent.
plugins.noteZh: 存在 dsh.client，但缺少 dsh.bundle 与引用 patch，因此暂缓。

plugins.name: Unified Agent Memory
plugins.summaryEn: A unified memory layer for retaining and retrieving agent knowledge across work.
plugins.summaryZh: 用于跨任务保存与检索 Agent 知识的统一记忆层。
plugins.noteEn: Manifest declares DSH tools rc.6 peers; runtime compatibility was not tested.
plugins.noteZh: manifest 声明 DSH tools rc.6 peer；未做运行兼容性测试。

plugins.name: DSH Web Search Exa
plugins.summaryEn: Exa-powered web search exposed to DSH as agent tools and Web settings.
plugins.summaryZh: 把 Exa 网络搜索接入 DSH 的 Agent 工具与 Web 设置。
plugins.noteEn: DSH peers declare rc.6 while the Cordis range remains rc.1; runtime was not tested.
plugins.noteZh: DSH peer 声明 rc.6，但 Cordis range 仍为 rc.1；未做运行测试。

plugins.name: DSH Diagram
plugins.summaryEn: Editable Excalidraw diagrams embedded in DeepSeek Harness conversations.
plugins.summaryZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中嵌入可编辑的 Excalidraw 图表。
plugins.noteEn: Exact rc.6 DSH peers were declared; runtime compatibility was not tested.
plugins.noteZh: 声明了精确的 DSH rc.6 peer；未做运行兼容性测试。

plugins.name: DSH Files
plugins.summaryEn: File upload cards, session-scoped storage, deduplication, cleanup, and document reading tools.
plugins.summaryZh: 提供文件上传卡片、会话隔离存储、去重清理与文档读取工具。
plugins.noteEn: DSH peers declare rc.6 while Cordis is broad; repository license detection was unavailable.
plugins.noteZh: DSH peer 声明 rc.6，Cordis range 较宽；仓库许可证检测结果未知。

plugins.name: DSH File Upload
plugins.summaryEn: Composer file upload with removable chips, content sniffing, Markdown conversion, and document tools.
plugins.summaryZh: 在输入区提供可移除的文件卡片、内容识别、Markdown 转换与文档工具。
plugins.noteEn: DSH peers declare rc.6 while Cordis is broad; runtime compatibility was not tested.
plugins.noteZh: DSH peer 声明 rc.6，Cordis range 较宽；未做运行兼容性测试。

plugins.name: DSH Turn Approval
plugins.summaryEn: Turn-scoped approval rules that expire after the current task.
plugins.summaryZh: 仅在当前任务内生效并随后过期的回合级审批规则。
plugins.noteEn: Only a Cordis peer is declared, so DSH compatibility remains unknown.
plugins.noteZh: 仅声明 Cordis peer，因此 DSH 兼容性仍未知。

plugins.name: DSH Approval LLM
plugins.summaryEn: An LLM-assisted approval layer for evaluating sensitive tool actions.
plugins.summaryZh: 使用 LLM 辅助评估敏感工具动作的审批层。
plugins.noteEn: Broad peer ranges leave compatibility unknown; repository license detection was unavailable.
plugins.noteZh: peer range 较宽，兼容性未知；仓库许可证检测结果不可用。

plugins.name: DSH WSL Workspace
plugins.summaryEn: Workspace support for using DeepSeek Harness across Windows and WSL paths.
plugins.summaryZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 与 WSL 路径之间的工作区支持。
plugins.noteEn: Broad DSH peer ranges leave runtime compatibility unknown.
plugins.noteZh: DSH peer range 较宽，运行兼容性仍未知。

plugins.name: DSH Git Graph
plugins.summaryEn: A read-only Git graph view with refs, worktree state, search, filtering, and history pagination.
plugins.summaryZh: 只读 Git 图谱视图，展示 refs、工作树状态、搜索、筛选与分页历史。
plugins.noteEn: Exact rc.6 DSH peers were declared; runtime compatibility was not tested.
plugins.noteZh: 声明了精确的 DSH rc.6 peer；未做运行兼容性测试。

plugins.name: DSH Ops Kit
plugins.summaryEn: Operational tools and skills for development workflows inside DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.summaryZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 内的开发流程提供运维工具与技能。
plugins.noteEn: DSH skill and tools peers declare rc.6; runtime compatibility was not tested.
plugins.noteZh: DSH skill 与 tools peer 声明 rc.6；未做运行兼容性测试。

plugins.name: DSH Eval Harness
plugins.summaryEn: A headless evaluation harness for measuring agent behavior and task outcomes.
plugins.summaryZh: 用于衡量 Agent 行为与任务结果的无头评估 Harness。
plugins.noteEn: A README owner spelling defect was observed; only a broad Cordis peer is declared.
plugins.noteZh: README 中存在 owner 拼写缺陷，且仅声明宽泛的 Cordis peer。

plugins.name: DSH ChatNode WeChat
plugins.summaryEn: A WeChat chat-node integration for connecting conversations to DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.summaryZh: 把微信聊天节点连接到 DeepSeek Harness 的集成。
plugins.noteEn: A prepare build can execute on source install; rc.6 support is documented but not declared as peers.
plugins.noteZh: 源码安装可能执行 prepare 构建；README 声称支持 rc.6，但 manifest 未声明相关 peer。

plugins.name: DSH GitHub Login
plugins.summaryEn: A GitHub login integration whose package name and patch row identity disagree.
plugins.summaryZh: GitHub 登录集成，但 package 名称与 patch row 身份不一致。
plugins.noteEn: Held until dsh-github-login and @deepseek-ai/dsh-github-login are aligned and rechecked.
plugins.noteZh: 需先统一 dsh-github-login 与 @deepseek-ai/dsh-github-login 的身份并复核，故暂缓。

plugins.name: DSH MCP Bridge
plugins.summaryEn: A bridge for exposing MCP servers and tools through a DSH Web bundle.
plugins.summaryZh: 通过 DSH Web bundle 暴露 MCP servers 与工具的桥接层。
plugins.noteEn: Web bundle structure was confirmed; the README records a separate headless dependency limitation.
plugins.noteZh: 已确认 Web bundle 结构；README 另有 headless 依赖限制记录。

plugins.name: DSH Computer Use
plugins.summaryEn: Computer-use tooling for screen perception and controlled desktop actions.
plugins.summaryZh: 用于屏幕感知与受控桌面操作的 Computer Use 工具。
plugins.noteEn: Exact rc.6 DSH peers were declared; broad computer control remains a high-trust capability.
plugins.noteZh: 声明了精确的 DSH rc.6 peer；广泛电脑控制仍属于高信任能力。

plugins.name: DSH Session Export
plugins.summaryEn: Exports DeepSeek Harness sessions into portable files for reuse or archival.
plugins.summaryZh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话导出为便于复用或归档的文件。
plugins.noteEn: Command, session, and tools peers declare rc.6; exported data may contain sensitive context.
plugins.noteZh: command、session 与 tools peer 声明 rc.6；导出数据可能包含敏感上下文。

plugins.name: DSH Find Plugin
plugins.summaryEn: An agent tool for searching the DSH plugin ecosystem from inside a conversation.
plugins.summaryZh: 让 Agent 在对话内搜索 DSH 插件生态的工具。
plugins.noteEn: Held because @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools still targets rc.1 rather than the rc.6 review baseline.
plugins.noteZh: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools 仍指向 rc.1，落后于 rc.6 核验基线，因此暂缓。

plugins.name: Creght Skills
plugins.summaryEn: A repository of agent skills packaged with a native DSH bundle.
plugins.summaryZh: 以原生 DSH bundle 打包的 Agent skills 仓库。
plugins.noteEn: No DSH peers are declared, so compatibility remains unknown.
plugins.noteZh: 未声明 DSH peer，因此兼容性仍未知。

plugins.name: DSH Blender
plugins.summaryEn: A Blender integration that exposes 3D scene authoring through DSH tools.
plugins.summaryZh: 通过 DSH 工具暴露 3D 场景创作能力的 Blender 集成。
plugins.noteEn: DSH tools rc.6 is declared; Blender execution and setup were not tested.
plugins.noteZh: 声明了 DSH tools rc.6；未执行 Blender 或其安装设置。

plugins.name: DSH Project Organizer
plugins.summaryEn: A conversation organizer whose fixed documentation says DSH is not currently supported.
plugins.summaryZh: 对话整理工具，但固定提交的文档明确表示目前不支持 DSH。
plugins.noteEn: Excluded because the author says DSH installation is not recommended and npm versions are deprecated.
plugins.noteZh: 作者明确不建议安装到 DSH，且 npm 版本已弃用，因此排除。

plugins.name: DSH Vision Router
plugins.summaryEn: A vision routing bundle with image Q&A, grounding, OCR, pixel inspection, screenshots, and provider chains.
plugins.summaryZh: 提供图像问答、定位、OCR、像素检查、截图与多提供商路由的视觉 bundle。
plugins.noteEn: The fixed manifest and patch declare rc.6 DSH peers; network providers, browser automation, file writes, and native image dependencies were not executed.
plugins.noteZh: 固定 manifest 与 patch 声明了 DSH rc.6 peer；未执行网络提供商、浏览器自动化、文件写入或原生图像依赖。

plugins.name: DSH Annotation
plugins.summaryEn: Adds numbered annotations to selected assistant text and carries them into the next message.
plugins.summaryZh: 为选中的助手文本添加编号批注，并把批注带入下一条消息。
plugins.noteEn: The Web client injection and native bundle row are fixed-source confirmed; no DSH package peer range establishes runtime compatibility.
plugins.noteZh: 已在固定源码确认 Web 客户端注入与原生 bundle 行；没有 DSH 包 peer 范围可用于确认运行兼容性。

plugins.name: DSH Context
plugins.summaryEn: A context insight panel for request history, compactions, injections, model switches, and composition changes.
plugins.summaryZh: 展示请求历史、压缩、注入、模型切换与上下文组成变化的洞察面板。
plugins.noteEn: The host/client bundle structure is confirmed; the prepare hook invokes Husky and the package declares no DSH peer range.
plugins.noteZh: 已确认 host/client bundle 结构；prepare hook 会调用 Husky，且包未声明 DSH peer 范围。

plugins.name: Tydora
plugins.summaryEn: A Tauri Markdown workspace containing an embedded DSH bundle entry.
plugins.summaryZh: 包含嵌入式 DSH bundle 入口的 Tauri Markdown 工作区。
plugins.noteEn: Held because the root package is a desktop application, the patch loads local TypeScript source, postinstall runs patch-package, and a separate install identity was not confirmed.
plugins.noteZh: 暂缓：根包是桌面应用，patch 加载本地 TypeScript 源码，postinstall 会运行 patch-package，且未确认独立安装身份。

plugins.name: DSH Codex
plugins.summaryEn: Connects ChatGPT OAuth, Codex models, search, remote image reading, and image generation to DSH.
plugins.summaryZh: 把 ChatGPT OAuth、Codex 模型、搜索、远程图片读取与图像生成接入 DSH。
plugins.noteEn: The fixed bundle is structurally valid; broad wildcard DSH peers and OAuth/model network access require independent compatibility and trust review.
plugins.noteZh: 固定 bundle 结构有效；宽泛的 DSH 通配 peer 以及 OAuth/模型网络访问仍需独立兼容性与信任审查。

plugins.name: DSH Sticky Note
plugins.summaryEn: A Web sticky-note panel that saves notes and TODO items into an archive directory.
plugins.summaryZh: 把笔记与 TODO 保存到归档目录的 Web 便签面板。
plugins.noteEn: The host and Web client faces are structurally confirmed; wildcard DSH peers and persistent note writes were not runtime-tested.
plugins.noteZh: 已确认 host 与 Web client 双端结构；未运行测试通配 DSH peer 与持久化便签写入。

plugins.name: DSH Search Boost
plugins.summaryEn: Fuses multiple Web and X search engines with page fetching and parallel research workflows.
plugins.summaryZh: 融合多个 Web 与 X 搜索引擎，并提供页面抓取与并行研究流程。
plugins.noteEn: The bundle row and search-provider override are fixed-source confirmed; external engines, credentials, subprocesses, and research fan-out were not executed.
plugins.noteZh: 已在固定源码确认 bundle 行与搜索提供商覆盖；未执行外部引擎、凭据、子进程或研究并发。

plugins.name: DSH Prompt Enhancer
plugins.summaryEn: Uses an independent LLM call to rewrite draft prompts in the DSH composer with undo support.
plugins.summaryZh: 通过独立 LLM 调用改写 DSH 输入框中的草稿提示词，并支持撤销。
plugins.noteEn: The client peers declare rc.6 and the native patch is present; prompt disclosure to a configured model and updater network behavior were not executed.
plugins.noteZh: 客户端 peer 声明 rc.6 且存在原生 patch；未执行向配置模型披露提示词或更新器网络行为。

plugins.name: DSH Drag-and-Drop Upload
plugins.summaryEn: Adds drag-and-drop uploads to the DSH Web composer and stores files in a local dropbox directory.
plugins.summaryZh: 为 DSH Web 输入框增加拖放上传，并把文件保存到本地 dropbox 目录。
plugins.noteEn: The dual host/client bundle is structurally confirmed; upload routes and filesystem writes were not runtime-tested.
plugins.noteZh: 已确认 host/client 双端 bundle 结构；未运行测试上传路由或文件系统写入。

plugins.name: DSH LLM Fallbacks
plugins.summaryEn: Adds configurable provider and model fallback chains after retry, authentication, quota, or rate-limit failures.
plugins.summaryZh: 在重试、认证、额度或限流失败后启用可配置的提供商与模型回退链。
plugins.noteEn: The DSH peers declare rc.6 and the fallback row is fixed-source confirmed; prepare builds code and provider switching was not runtime-tested.
plugins.noteZh: DSH peer 声明 rc.6 且已在固定源码确认回退行；prepare 会构建代码，未运行测试提供商切换。

plugins.name: DSH Plugin Market
plugins.summaryEn: A verified-first Web catalog that searches GitHub plugin leads and gates install-command copying behind structural checks.
plugins.summaryZh: 一个优先验证的 Web 插件目录，可搜索 GitHub 候选，并在结构检查后才允许复制安装命令。
plugins.noteEn: The fixed Git-source bundle is confirmed; the unscoped npm name resolves to a different repository, so no npm identity is listed and no remote check or install action was executed.
plugins.noteZh: 已确认固定 Git 源 bundle；同名 npm 包指向另一仓库，因此不列 npm 身份，且未执行远程检查或安装操作。

plugins.name: DSH Search
plugins.summaryEn: Provides model-callable Web search through Bing RSS with a DuckDuckGo fallback and no required API key.
plugins.summaryZh: 通过 Bing RSS 与 DuckDuckGo 回退提供模型可调用的网页搜索，无需 API Key。
plugins.noteEn: The fixed monorepo subdirectory and patch are confirmed; the author documents clone-plus-local-path installation, and the repository has no detected license file.
plugins.noteZh: 已确认固定提交中的单仓库子目录与 patch；作者记录的是克隆后本地路径安装，仓库未检测到许可证文件。

plugins.name: DSH Plugin Hot Toggle
plugins.summaryEn: Starts and stops installed Cordis plugin entries from DSH Web and persists the selected state across restarts.
plugins.summaryZh: 在 DSH Web 中启动或停止已安装的 Cordis 插件条目，并跨重启保存选择状态。
plugins.noteEn: The package and patch identities align; dynamic loader control, persisted configuration writes, and the prepare build were not executed.
plugins.noteZh: 包与 patch 身份一致；未执行动态 Loader 控制、持久化配置写入或 prepare 构建。

plugins.name: Chicheng Gate
plugins.summaryEn: Adds LAN and tunneled DSH panel access with a password gate, trusted-host configuration, and managed frpc connectivity.
plugins.summaryZh: 为 DSH 面板增加局域网和隧道访问、密码门禁、可信主机配置与托管 frpc 连接。
plugins.noteEn: Static source shows frpc download with checksum verification, archive extraction, credential storage, subprocess launch, and DSH restart paths; none were executed.
plugins.noteZh: 静态源码显示 frpc 下载与校验、解压、凭据存储、子进程启动及 DSH 重启路径；均未执行。

plugins.name: DSH Capability Index
plugins.summaryEn: Injects per-step capability hints so agents can select installed plugins from an indexed trigger table before acting.
plugins.summaryZh: 向运行上下文注入逐步能力提示，让 Agent 在执行前从触发表索引中选择已安装插件。
plugins.noteEn: The root bundle is distinct from the repository's demo fixture; no DSH peer range establishes runtime compatibility.
plugins.noteZh: 根 bundle 已与仓库中的演示夹具区分；没有 DSH peer 范围可用于确认运行兼容性。

plugins.name: DSH Usage Billing
plugins.summaryEn: Aggregates model token usage and estimated DeepSeek charges into persistent session and time-range dashboards.
plugins.summaryZh: 聚合模型 Token 用量与 DeepSeek 费用估算，并提供持久化的会话和时间范围面板。
plugins.noteEn: The DSH tools peer declares rc.6 and the fixed source writes aggregated usage data; pricing accuracy and runtime behavior were not verified.
plugins.noteZh: DSH tools peer 声明 rc.6，固定源码会写入聚合用量数据；未验证计价准确性或运行行为。

plugins.name: DSH Web Tools
plugins.summaryEn: Unifies multiple Web search and fetch providers with credential pools, quotas, health tracking, and deterministic fallback.
plugins.summaryZh: 统一多个网页搜索与抓取提供商，并提供凭据池、额度、健康监控和确定性回退。
plugins.noteEn: The fixed peers declare rc.6; provider calls, credential handling, quota logic, fallback behavior, and the prepare build were not executed.
plugins.noteZh: 固定 peer 声明 rc.6；未执行提供商调用、凭据处理、额度逻辑、回退行为或 prepare 构建。

plugins.name: DSH Autonomy
plugins.summaryEn: Adds per-session autonomy levels that alter system-prompt directives from strict through more exploratory behavior.
plugins.summaryZh: 为每个会话增加自主程度档位，通过系统提示指令从严格行为调整到更探索性的行为。
plugins.noteEn: Held because the documented unscoped npm identity currently resolves to JinkaiLiu/dsh-autonomy, not this repository; local source installation remains separately documented.
plugins.noteZh: 暂缓：文档中的无作用域 npm 身份目前指向 JinkaiLiu/dsh-autonomy，而非本仓库；本地源码安装另有记录。

plugins.name: DSH Request Flight Recorder
plugins.summaryEn: Records bounded content-free diagnostics for request timing, streaming phases, failures, and session correlation.
plugins.summaryZh: 记录有界且不含内容的请求耗时、流式阶段、失败和会话关联诊断信息。
plugins.noteEn: Exact rc.6 DSH peers and the native bundle are fixed-source confirmed; privacy properties, timing hooks, and the prepack build were not runtime-tested.
plugins.noteZh: 已在固定源码确认精确 rc.6 DSH peer 与原生 bundle；未运行测试隐私属性、计时 hook 或 prepack 构建。

plugins.name: DSH Effort
plugins.summaryEn: Adds a Web control for selecting the current session model's supported reasoning-effort level.
plugins.summaryZh: 在 Web 界面中增加当前会话模型所支持的推理强度选择控件。
plugins.noteEn: The fixed source uses session model RPCs and browser storage; the repository has no detected license file and declares no DSH peer range.
plugins.noteZh: 固定源码使用会话模型 RPC 与浏览器存储；仓库未检测到许可证文件，且没有声明 DSH peer 范围。

plugins.name: DSH Sound
plugins.summaryEn: Plays configurable browser sounds for task completion, approvals, questions, plan review, blocking, and failures.
plugins.summaryZh: 为任务完成、审批、提问、计划审核、阻塞和失败播放可配置的浏览器提示音。
plugins.noteEn: The fixed source stores configuration in localStorage and audio in IndexedDB; the documented npm target currently exposes no published version and no runtime behavior was tested.
plugins.noteZh: 固定源码把配置存入 localStorage、音频存入 IndexedDB；文档所列 npm 目标目前没有可用版本，且未测试运行行为。

plugins.name: DSH Safe Plugin Manager
plugins.summaryEn: A GitHub-only plugin catalog and guarded profile lifecycle manager with plans, confirmations, backups, checks, and rollback.
plugins.summaryZh: 一个仅面向 GitHub 的插件目录和受控 Profile 生命周期管理器，提供计划、确认、备份、检查与回滚。
plugins.noteEn: The private, UNLICENSED package is documented as GitHub-only; profile mutation, backups, subprocess execution, remote catalogs, and rollback were not executed.
plugins.noteZh: 该 private、UNLICENSED 包被记录为仅 GitHub 来源；未执行 Profile 修改、备份、子进程、远程目录或回滚。

plugins.name: DSH Usage
plugins.summaryEn: Shows persistent balances and token-usage dashboards across DSH sessions and optional Claude Code usage logs.
plugins.summaryZh: 展示持久化余额与 Token 用量面板，覆盖 DSH 会话及可选的 Claude Code 用量日志。
plugins.noteEn: The author documents GitHub-source installation; the private manifest name collides with another npm repository, so no npm identity is listed and usage, balance, and file access were not executed.
plugins.noteZh: 作者记录了 GitHub 源安装；private manifest 名称与另一 npm 仓库冲突，因此不列 npm 身份，且未执行用量、余额或文件访问。

plugins.name: DSH Forge
plugins.summaryEn: A broad extension bundle for cross-session mail, agent teams, model routing, runtime injection, skills, and plugin management.
plugins.summaryZh: 一个广泛的扩展 bundle，覆盖跨会话邮件、Agent 团队、模型路由、运行时注入、技能与插件管理。
plugins.noteEn: The distributable npm bundle, rather than the private root source manifest, declares rc.6 peers; its broad runtime injection and management surfaces were not executed.
plugins.noteZh: 收录的是声明 rc.6 peer 的可分发 npm bundle，而非 private 根源码 manifest；未执行其广泛的运行时注入与管理能力。

plugins.name: DSH Notify Win
plugins.summaryEn: Shows native Windows task and question notifications, flashes the taskbar, and can return toast answers to DSH.
plugins.summaryZh: 显示原生 Windows 任务与提问通知、闪烁任务栏，并可把 Toast 回答传回 DSH。
plugins.noteEn: The package ships an executable plus PowerShell and VBScript helpers and spawns notification processes; no native helper, subprocess, question flow, or prepublish hook was executed.
plugins.noteZh: 包内携带可执行文件、PowerShell 与 VBScript 辅助程序并启动通知进程；未执行原生程序、子进程、提问流程或 prepublish hook。

plugins.name: DSH QQ Remote
plugins.summaryEn: Controls DSH over a OneBot QQ bridge with remote commands, task dispatch, screenshots, chat, sessions, and progress events.
plugins.summaryZh: 通过 OneBot QQ 桥远程控制 DSH，提供命令执行、任务派发、截图、聊天、会话和进度事件。
plugins.noteEn: The fixed source exposes remote command, screenshot, session, file, credential, and subprocess surfaces through QQ; its separate installer and all runtime paths were not executed.
plugins.noteZh: 固定源码通过 QQ 暴露远程命令、截图、会话、文件、凭据和子进程能力；独立安装脚本及所有运行路径均未执行。

plugins.name: DSH Codex Media
plugins.summaryEn: Adds local image and document analysis plus image generation through Codex CLI or configurable API transports.
plugins.summaryZh: 通过 Codex CLI 或可配置 API 传输增加本地图像与文档分析以及图像生成。
plugins.noteEn: The native row loads source that can read files, spawn the local Codex CLI, call APIs, and write generated images; none of those paths were executed.
plugins.noteZh: 原生条目加载的源码可读取文件、启动本地 Codex CLI、调用 API 并写入生成图片；这些路径均未执行。

plugins.name: DSH WeChat Pro
plugins.summaryEn: Connects WeChat contacts to real DSH workspaces, sessions, prompts, approvals, event streams, and media transfers.
plugins.summaryZh: 把微信联系人接入真实 DSH 工作区、会话、提示、审批、事件流和媒体传输。
plugins.noteEn: The package uses wildcard DSH peers and handles WeChat credentials, prompts, approvals, session events, and media files; none were runtime-tested.
plugins.noteZh: 该包使用通配 DSH peer，并处理微信凭据、提示、审批、会话事件和媒体文件；均未运行测试。

plugins.name: DSH Stop Server
plugins.summaryEn: Adds a Web action that calls a host shutdown route to stop the DSH process and close the current interface.
plugins.summaryZh: 增加一个调用宿主关闭路由的 Web 操作，用于停止 DSH 进程并关闭当前界面。
plugins.noteEn: The fixed host source registers a shutdown route with appExit, process.exit, and SIGTERM fallbacks; the repository has no detected license file and shutdown was not executed.
plugins.noteZh: 固定宿主源码注册了带 appExit、process.exit 与 SIGTERM 回退的关闭路由；仓库未检测到许可证文件，且未执行关闭。

plugins.name: DSH Island
plugins.summaryEn: A macOS menu-bar island and whale companion that displays DSH sessions, tools, progress, and approval requests.
plugins.summaryZh: 一个 macOS 菜单栏灵动岛与鲸鱼桌宠，用于显示 DSH 会话、工具、进度和审批请求。
plugins.noteEn: The source spawns a bundled macOS panel and forwards tool arguments, session paths, and approval decisions over a local socket; no native code or prepublish hook was executed.
plugins.noteZh: 源码会启动随包 macOS 面板，并通过本地 Socket 转发工具参数、会话路径和审批决定；未执行原生代码或 prepublish hook。
